cards.card_text: The LORD sent the hornet ahead of them, and He gave them cities they didn't build and vineyards and olive groves they didn't plant.
cards.verse_text: So I gave you a land on which you did not toil and cities that you did not build, and now you live in them and eat from vineyards and olive groves that you did not plant.’

cards.card_text: True or false: The fire from Samson's foxes stops before it reaches the Philistines' vineyards and olive groves.
cards.verse_text: Then he lit the torches and released the foxes into the standing grain of the Philistines, burning up the piles of grain and the standing grain, as well as the vineyards and olive groves.
